title: 64N Nutraceutical for the Prevention of Childhood Diarrhea and Pneumonia in Low Resource Settings
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to compare the occurrence of childhood diarrheal disease and pneumonia in subjects under the age of 5 years in low resource settings who have received prophylactic 64N nutraceutical (64N)as a neonate as compared with neonates who have not received prophylactic 64N.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Healthy neonates

Exclusion Criteria:

* Neonates with milk intolerance
* Neonates with lactose intolerance
* Premature neonates
* Neonates in poor health or who are being followed by a medical provider for illness
